messages:
Priya: opened a short PR to reconcile audit export docs and SDK snippets (ruby + go) after the last SOC2 review. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/512

Carlos: thanks. main ask from compliance was to avoid 'permanent deletion' phrasing without context. suggest: 'irreversible removal following retention expiry' or 'removed after retention period unless subject to hold'.

Priya: makes sense. i'll swap instances of 'permanently delete' for 'irreversible removal following retention expiry' and add a note about legal holds.

Jen: small docs-dev note: the Ruby SDK example in the PR uses `client.export_audit_logs(tenant_id: ...)` but the real method is `client.audit_logs.export(...)` in v2. can update snippet to match current gem. also add a minimal Go example for platform teams.

Priya: pushing updated snippets now. preview: ```bash
# curl export example (auth header required)
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export?tenant=acme&since=180d&redact=pseudonymize" \
  -o audit_export.json
```

Priya: and small Ruby SDK snippet: ```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_KEY'])
client.audit_logs.export(tenant: 'acme', since: '180d', redact: 'pseudonymize')
```

Priya: Go snippet: ```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
resp, err := client.AuditLogs.Export(ctx, redwood.ExportParams{Tenant: "acme", Since: "180d", Redact: "pseudonymize"})
```

Marcus: nice. compliance asked for a one-liner explaining pseudonymization vs redaction for docs readers. propose: 'Pseudonymization replaces direct identifiers with stable tokens to preserve referential integrity for investigations; redaction removes sensitive fields entirely.'

Carlos: short wording tweak: include an example that pseudonymization preserves an actor_id but removes the actor_email. that helps auditors.

Priya: added sentence and updated PR. also clarified that exported artifacts include event IDs and timestamps so they can be re-ingested for analysis, and that export configuration does not change server-side retention settings.

legal-bot: automated check: replaced flagged phrase 'destroy immediately' with approved phrasing 'irreversible removal following retention expiry'.

docs-bot: running spellcheck + linkcheck + code-sample lint on PR #512

docs-bot: linkcheck found one outdated internal reference to /docs/old-export which was auto-fixed in latest commit

docs-bot: code-sample lint: Ruby snippet now matches gem v2 signatures; Go snippet lint passed with minor formatting suggestion (fixed)

Jen: LGTM from devex. small accessibility note: add alt text for the export flow diagram referenced near the top.

Priya: added alt text and a short caption linking to the SOC2 checklist entry. pushed.

Carlos: compliance okayed the final language. legal signoff received from @legal-bot. :white_check_mark:

docs-bot: PR #512 mergeable; CI green (spellcheck, linkcheck, sample-lint)

Priya: merged. leaving a short CHANGES.md entry and filing a follow-up to sync the CLI cheat sheet with the `redact=pseudonymize` option.

Marcus: thanks all 389 will chase the cheat sheet update in next sprint.

Jen: closing thread.
